column2: Retinol Activity Equivalents: FDA regulation for measuring Vitamin A

Daily Folate Equivalents: FDA regulation for measuring Vitamin B9 (Folate) 
(1 mcg folic acid = 1.7 mcg DFE)
International Unit: Vitamin D is the only FDA approved Vitamin to list IUs but must follow weight in mcg

Blends will be expressed by composite weight in the Ingredient List 
and broken down here in the companion sheet. If the blend is not broken down by the vendors CoA or Spec 
sheet then it will just be listed as its composite weight.

If a B(2) dietary ingredient (meaning it has a daily value) is present at less than 2% of the Daily 
value it does not need to be listed in the supplement facts panel and can be listed in other ingredients.
An Ingredient is Present but is not listed by input amount on the Spec Sheet/CoA.

These ingredients reflect directly what the CoA/ Spec sheet lists. Some of our labels have discrepancies that do not
match the ingredient list in wieght or the ingredient's source.
